name: Anna
source:
Confidence, talent, success. Anna has it all. Despite not taking rules seriously all the time, she has made it far in life thanks to her own job being her greatest passion. The arrival of humans has also aroused her scientific curiosity. Be careful, though, as that passion could turn into a temper.

[From [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/angels-with-scaly-wings--3#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
